scope: Different-author fail-closed source hammer of the additive M1823 TSBG production-governance runner, checker, tests, contract, and sealed author receipt. CPython static and in-memory semantic probes only; no EDA, license query, release, attempt, result, source edit, predecessor edit, or docs359 edit was performed.
verdict: FAIL-CLOSED. M1823 genuinely closes the exact nine M1813 mutations and adds the external self-runner-pin mutation: Python 3.6 and 3.10 each pass the source checker, parse all three Python sources, and reject the complete declared 58/58 suite. The concrete runner currently contains the correct authority/source/namespace/flock/collision/resource/attempt/quarantine/atomic-publish sequence, and all frozen M1794/M1795/M1812/M1813/docs359 identities match. Nevertheless, the claim that those governance boundaries are semantically non-bypassable remains too broad. The new AST checker proves names and direct-call order but not critical arguments or gate bodies, and it does not enforce the complete M1812/M1813 future-release identity. A separate twelve-attack equivalent-bypass probe escaped 12/12: both flock modes and one handle can be weakened, canonical atomic publication can be made unreachable, the source-contract authority target can be misbound, ATTEMPT can be removed from the namespace set, collision and resource gates can be made vacuous, and four M1812/M1813 identity keys can be removed from expected_identity. Exact contract SHA still protects this particular file, but it is deliberately not semantic evidence under the M1795-M1823 methodology. M1825 and VCS are therefore not authorized.

findings.title: Governance AST checks remain name-level and permit equivalent bypasses of required gate semantics
findings.evidence: validate_runner_reachability verifies the ordered direct-call names and three legacy identity keys, but does not validate flock handles/modes, the namespaces_fresh tuple, collision blocked set, resource thresholds, authority-pin targets other than the self-runner pin, direct reachability of canonical atomic publication, or the M1812/M1813 review-manifest-outer keys in expected_identity. Twelve in-memory changes at those exact boundaries all passed validate_semantics.
findings.risk: A successor can retain the required names and token strings while turning mutual exclusion, freshness, resource exclusion, source authority, result publication, or transitive predecessor identity into a no-op or misbinding. This would make the source hammer unable to justify the sole no-retry VCS launch even though the present frozen runner happens to be correct.
findings.required_fix: Do not overwrite M1823. In an additive successor, AST-check both flock calls for exact handles and LOCK_EX/LOCK_NB expressions; require the complete seven-entry namespace tuple; validate the collision set and nonzero resource thresholds; parse exact authority target/pin pairs; require canonical and quarantine publish_no_replace calls as direct reachable statements; and enforce exact sha(...) values for M1812 plus M1813 review, manifest, and outer seal. Add explicit mutations for all twelve equivalent bypasses and obtain a fresh different-author zero-P0/P1 hammer before any release or VCS.
